# Country scope. Valid East Slavic / Russian host for the Early Modern line (1600-1800).
oe_rem_is_rus_host_candidate = {
    is_rebel_country = no
    OR = {
        tag = RUS
        oe_rus_country = yes
    }
}

# Country scope. Fast O(1) gate for oe_rem_pulse.txt fallback pulse.
oe_rem_pulse_host_candidate = {
    is_rebel_country = no
    OR = {
        tag = RUS
        AND = {
            NOT = { country_exists = c:RUS }
            OR = {
                tag = MOS
                tag = NOV
                tag = KIE
                tag = TVE
                AND = { is_ai = no oe_rus_country = yes }
            }
        }
    }
}

# Any scope. True when global_var:oe_rem_host points to a live, non-rebel country.
oe_rem_has_live_host = {
    has_global_variable = oe_rem_host
    trigger_if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_rem_host }
        country_exists = global_var:oe_rem_host
        global_var:oe_rem_host = { is_rebel_country = no }
    }
}

# Any scope. Age of Absolutism or Revolutions (EU5 1.4.9 verified keys).
oe_rem_in_absolutism_or_later = {
    OR = {
        current_age = age_5_absolutism
        current_age = age_6_revolutions
    }
}

# Country scope. Phase 1/2 path inheritance (1 Moscow / 2 Novgorod / 3 Kyiv-Tver) with safe trigger_if guards.
oe_rem_is_path_2 = {
    OR = {
        AND = {
            has_variable = oe_rpl_path
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_rpl_path } var:oe_rpl_path = 2 }
        }
        AND = {
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_rpl_path }
            OR = { tag = NOV government_type = government_type:republic }
        }
    }
}

oe_rem_is_path_3 = {
    OR = {
        AND = {
            has_variable = oe_rpl_path
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_rpl_path } var:oe_rpl_path = 3 }
        }
        AND = {
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_rpl_path }
            OR = { tag = KIE tag = TVE tag = SMO }
        }
    }
}

oe_rem_is_path_1 = {
    NOT = { oe_rem_is_path_2 = yes }
    NOT = { oe_rem_is_path_3 = yes }
}

# Country scope. True when Petrine Westernization succeeded (hook for v8.5 oe_mil_).
oe_rem_has_peter_reform = {
    has_variable = oe_rem_peter_reform
    trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_rem_peter_reform } var:oe_rem_peter_reform = 1 }
}

# Country scope. Streltsy mutiny crisis triggers when traditionalist unrest reaches 50+, or harsh westernization under low stability.
oe_rem_streltsy_crisis_due = {
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_rem_streltsy_resolved }
    OR = {
        AND = {
            has_variable = oe_rem_trad_unrest
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_rem_trad_unrest } var:oe_rem_trad_unrest >= 50 }
        }
        AND = {
            has_variable = oe_rem_westernization
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_rem_westernization } var:oe_rem_westernization = 1 }
            stability < 20
        }
    }
}

# Country scope. Holds Neva directly (verified EU5 1.4.9 key: neva).

    owns = location:neva

# Country scope. Holds Siberian or Far Eastern frontier corridor.

    OR = {
        AND = {

    }
}

# Any scope. Living New Rome (c:ROM or c:BYZ) controls Constantinople, Kaffa, or Tana (has_owner guarded).
oe_rem_new_rome_holds_straits = {
    OR = {
        location:constantinople = {
            has_owner = yes
            OR = {
                AND = { country_exists = c:ROM owner = c:ROM }
                AND = { country_exists = c:BYZ owner = c:BYZ }
            }
        }
        location:kaffa = {
            has_owner = yes
            OR = {
                AND = { country_exists = c:ROM owner = c:ROM }
                AND = { country_exists = c:BYZ owner = c:BYZ }
            }
        }
        location:tana = {
            has_owner = yes
            OR = {
                AND = { country_exists = c:ROM owner = c:ROM }
                AND = { country_exists = c:BYZ owner = c:BYZ }
            }
        }
    }
}
